How to read this app

Every verse can be tapped open. Underneath it you'll find the original Greek where it matters, the Old Testament passage it's quoting or fulfilling, the historical setting, and what it means for an ordinary day. Gold dots mark books with commentary ready now — we are building toward the whole New Testament, one chapter at a time.

Text: King James Version (public domain) · Commentary written from the shared witness of the early Church, the Reformers, and the Fathers before every division.
